title: Boston Gas Company submits for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 275 Day Transportation Agreement with Mclean Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: This pricing structure is in accordance with the Department's standard and the Department, therefore, APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure, pursuant to G.L. c. 25 §5D. The Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul b. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 00-19)
